name: East India Drums & Barrels Manufacturing Ltd
summary: East India Drums & Barrels Manufacturing Ltd., an Indian company, focuses on the manufacturing and sale of various drums, barrels, and related industrial containers. Its product line encompasses diverse options such as closed-top, open-top, gooseneck, composite, and galvanized drums. Established in 2013, the enterprise was previously known as Precision Containeurs Limited until it rebranded to its current name in April 2024. The company's principal operations are based in Mumbai, India.
